name: Pioneer Minerals Limited
summary: Pioneer Minerals Limited, a mineral company, engages in the exploration and development of mineral projects in Australia, Canada, the United States, Namibia, and Brazil. It also explores for rare earth elements and lithium. The company holds an interest in Warmbad Uranium Project, located in Namibia, covering an area of 271 square kilometers; Skull Creek Uranium Project, located in the United States, covering an area of 15.5 square kilometers; and a 90% interest in Root Lake Project covering an area of 1,972 hectares located in Ontario and Quebec, Canada. The company was formerly known as Pioneer Lithium Limited and changed its name to Pioneer Minerals Limited in November 2025. The company was incorporated in 2022 and is based in Perth, Australia.
